sections.title: How Weapons Work
sections.content:
Each Expedition 33 character has their own weapon set. There are 102 weapons in total, spread over 5 sets - Gustave and Verso share theirs. Every weapon has an elemental damage type and scales off one primary stat, so the choice is about which element you want on the character and which of their stats you are feeding.

Elements matter most against Nevrons and bosses, which resist or absorb specific types - see enemy weaknesses before spending upgrade resources on a weapon you will not keep.

sections.title: Which to Upgrade
sections.content: Upgrading a weapon is permanent per character, so the usual advice is to pick one weapon per character early and stay with it rather than spreading resources. For current picks see best weapons and the weapons tier list; every location is collected on weapon locations.
